Title: Vijendra Kumar – Software Engineer | Backend Specialist | AI & Web Developer

URL Source: https://vijevira.in/

Markdown Content:
## 👋 Hi, I'm Vijendra Kumar

I'm a **Senior Software Engineer at Apsona**, based in Bangalore, India, where I focus on **backend engineering, Salesforce automation,** and **DevOps** — things like Vault-based secrets management, triggered merge automation, and scheduler tooling.

My career started at **TCS** in 2021, and I later spent time at **Pratishthan Software Ventures** building real-time payment infrastructure for banks — **SEPA**, **SWIFT**, **NACH**, **QCBIP**, and **UAERT**. Outside my day job I build side projects, from multiplayer games to **AI-powered tools** and SaaS platforms, and I've solved **350+ coding problems** across various platforms.

### 🛠️ What I work with

*   Node.js, Python, TypeScript, Shell scripting
*   PostgreSQL, Redis, Node-RED
*   HashiCorp Vault, Salesforce, AWS Lambda/SQS
*   Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, Docker, Turborepo

### 🔗 Explore

*   📖 Read the full story on [About](https://vijevira.in/about)
*   💻 Browse what I've built in [Projects](https://vijevira.in/projects)
*   📄 See my full career history on my [Resume](https://vijevira.in/resume)

### 🚀 Let's Build Something Amazing

I'm always open to exciting collaborations, freelance gigs, or full-time roles where I can solve real problems, learn with smart folks, and make a meaningful impact. [Say hello](mailto:vijevira@engineer.com) — let's build something awesome together!

Markdown Content:
![Image 1: Rahul's avatar](https://rahulv.dev/me.png)

Software engineer and product builder.

I've spent about a decade building products across different domains, from interfaces and developer tools to backend systems, games, and platforms. I'm still curious about all of it.

I like working close to the product: understanding the problem, designing the system, building it, and seeing it used.

Outside work, I maintain [Igris Labs](https://igrislabs.com/), a small software lab for open-source projects, experiments, and things I want to exist.

You can find me on [GitHub](https://github.com/rahul-vashishtha), read my [writing](https://rahulv.dev/blog), or take a look at my [résumé](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ntVH-w_4ZJu0MQ3bv0dg7SQNvwIaoKdZXtOK_i30PDU/export?format=pdf). If you'd like to talk, [schedule a call](https://calendly.com/rahul-vashishtha/30min) or .
